summary: Retest of the iteration_16 fixes. Backend: 8/8 pytest tests pass (5 in test_dr_delete_and_notes.py plus 3 new in test_dr_delete_iter17.py), and manual_dr_delete_reversal.py reports ALL PASS. The out-of-order delete bug is fixed. With 2 DRs (25/55), deleting the older one keeps the task at 55, with last_synced pointing at DR2 and DR1's hours subtracted. Then deleting DR2 gives 0 / not_started / last_synced_from_dr=null, and hours go back to the baseline. With 3 DRs (10/30/60), deleting the middle one keeps 60. Deleting the newest falls back to 10 / in_progress, with last_synced pointing at the oldest DR. Deleting that one gives 0 / null. A notes-only PATCH with a 2020 task_last_modified_at stamp now returns 200; a pct PATCH with the same stamp still returns 409 as it should. UI: the locked-reason card on the desktop guided view is styled correctly at 1920x800 (bordered card, full-width 1568px textarea, '0 / 10 min chars' counter). Desktop note save (drgx-act-note) persisted, confirmed via the API. Mobile note save (dr-flow-act-note) showed 'Note saved' and was prefilled with the desktop note. The trash icon on the desktop DR list was STILL wrapping below 'Open'. Root cause: the button had both the 'grid' and 'inline-flex' classes, and Tailwind outputs .grid later, so display:grid (block-level) won. I fixed this (replaced with inline-flex items-center justify-center), and it is now inline (same y).

ui_bugs.issue: Trash button wrapped below Open because the 'grid' and 'inline-flex' classes conflicted. FIXED by testing agent.

critical_code_review_comments: _progress_without_dr queries daily_report_activities without tenant_filter (it relies on UUID ids). Wrapping it in tenant_filter would be safer.

_progress_without_dr's fallback baseline uses the earliest task_sync_event 'before' value, including events from already-deleted DRs. This is correct today because those events are kept. If events are ever purged or tombstoned, the baseline logic must be revisited.
daily_reports_router.py is 2677 lines and should be split.
